marketing_description: The SATCO Retrofit Downlight (S11801R1) delivers 2,000 lm at 9 W, operates on 120 V (0.2 A, 60 Hz) and fits a 6‑in ceiling opening with a 10‑15/16 in diameter round steel housing finished in white. It incorporates a single LED bulb (75 W equivalent, E26 base) with selectable color temperatures from 2700 K to 5000 K, CRI 90+, dimmable operation, a frosted polycarbonate lens, IP20 enclosure, and features air‑tight construction, IC rating, remote driver, and a 90° beam angle.
